scenario: `count(r.val)` function-call aggregation (the window is the declaration's, LSER.6.11.3) fires rule when accumulated count >= 3 per LSER.16.1. Requires a series declaration for the backing. After 4 observations (one per pump cycle so accumulator absorbs before next check), count reaches 3 → rule fires. Pin: action_log appears in the event stream.
rules_ds:
use default

schema Reading scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    val: Float mutable

series Reading.val:
    count sliding 5_s

rule check:
    Reading r where count(r.val) >= 3
->
    log info "count reached"
